- The client knows nothing about drives or shards

div.b: MinIO splits it into four shards

div.span: - Two shards carry content and two carry recovery information, and MinIO decides per object which drive holds which
- One shard per drive, so no single drive has a fixed role

div.span: - The GET returns the original bytes and a 200 response
- Parity costs about 100 percent overhead: the object occupies 2x its size, against 3x for three-way replication
